events.factual_description: Jazz at Lincoln Center presents Marsalis and the Masters on September 17-19, 2026 at 7:30 PM in Rose Theater. Wynton Marsalis and the Jazz at Lincoln Center Orchestra perform Marsalis's big-band interpretations of music by Thelonious Monk, Louis Armstrong, John Coltrane, Chick Corea and other jazz masters; Jazz at Lincoln Center's official season announcement also names Wayne Shorter among the composers represented. The 2026-27 season is Marsalis's final season as Artistic Director after nearly four decades as the institution's founder and driving force.

en.why_it_matters: The reason this clears S is not simply Wynton plus the JLCO. Marsalis is using the orchestra he built to refract Monk, Armstrong, Coltrane, Corea, Shorter and other foundational voices through his own arranging language during his final season leading Jazz at Lincoln Center. That makes the concert both an argument about the jazz canon and a document of the institution Marsalis shaped for nearly forty years.
en.trip_verdict: S regional. Worth a dedicated New York trip from the DMV, especially in this final-season context; the three-night run keeps it below S+, but the program is substantially more consequential than a routine JLCO date.

es.why_it_matters: Cruza el umbral S no simplemente por Wynton y la JLCO. Marsalis utiliza la orquesta que construyó para refractar a Monk, Armstrong, Coltrane, Corea, Shorter y otras voces fundamentales a través de su propio lenguaje de arreglos durante su última temporada al frente de Jazz at Lincoln Center. Eso vuelve el concierto a la vez una discusión viva sobre el canon del jazz y un documento de la institución que Marsalis moldeó durante casi cuarenta años.
es.trip_verdict: S regional. Sí vale un viaje dedicado a Nueva York desde el DMV, especialmente por el contexto de su temporada final; la residencia de tres noches lo mantiene por debajo de S+, pero el programa es bastante más importante que una fecha rutinaria de la JLCO.
